notes:
- OpenEXR opens with its passes: beauty, depth, Cryptomatte objects as masks, and normals for Depth Lighting. Finish layers take an Object mask on an EXR.
- Finish layers export with the photograph, into the one EXR or as sibling TIFFs; the Export Layer node writes any wire. TIFF keeps its alpha and adds 32-bit float.
- Layers from File brings a layered EXR or a multi-page TIFF into the Finish stack.
- Color Checker calibrates the camera from a photographed chart.
- Preferences > Interface > Adjustment sections hides or pins any section of the Adjustments panel.
- An older catalog asks before it is updated, backups are verified, and Restore catalog from copy is the safe way back.
- Thumbnails load as you scroll, so large folders stay responsive.
- Fixed: HDR stacks merged too bright when the long exposure sorted first; renders and EXRs opened over a stop bright; EXR thumbnails and transparent edges; Depth Lighting halos on a file's depth pass; stacks failing over old catalog rows; the EULA showing as Markdown in the installers.
